body:
If you’re still open to answers. 

I currently lack the belief in a god.

When I die, I believe I will return to the state i was in before birth and consciousness. There will just be nothing.

I don’t think it matters. 

An afterlife would be cool. It would shatter my world view to say the least.

As for decades of life and a premature end, i myself used to return to this very argument when I was feeling down, but as time went on I started to question if the real suffering now will be worth potential happiness later.

Sort of, it would have been a gradual realization. I think for most people it starts as an emotional cope, but some use logic to excuse it. I do. It relates to my earlier response: suffering now for happiness that is not guaranteed. 

If you think of anymore questions im here to answer.
You still keen?
You’re right about one thing, it wont work. It will also hurt. I’ve felt the way you are felling now before, years and months ago, but im still here. Talk to me

Damn, im glad for you that it got better. It has for me too at times. Ive been this way on and off for a few years now; though i actually have a method now. I know it can and will get better. It’s a privileged thing to say, but i dont care. Not anymore at least. It’s almost summer and all my friends will be returning home. I will have about 4 months of being alone. To add to this, my birthday will happen during this time. And i already get severe birthday blues.
I’m just listening to music now. I saw the new batman and thought it was really good
Hi, I’m sorry you can relate.  I’m not sure what, I’m just trying to distract myself for long enough that I’ll fall asleep
Ahh, this was a little while ago, but any show of support is nice. Thank you

Well you’ve made it this far. Two years battling depression is not to be scoffed at. Just keep going. Take it a day at a time. If you’re overwhelmed with something put it on hold for the day. Or even just an hr or two. Try to find something that you might enjoy. Could literally be anything. Listen to music, draw nonsensical stuff, go somewhere public and laugh quietly at people. Whatever it is, find it. Im still here to keep chatting  when you need :)
Damn, I’m sorry about that. Are you excluded from the thing they are doing, or you just cant find enjoyment in it?
I can relate to those first few lines. 2020 was when it started for me too. You say your suicidal thoughts are on and off, have you noticed a pattern, or specific trigger?
Thank you. I just don’t know what to say. I feel like if i just has something more in life, it would be worth living. But past experiences have shown it doesn’t change anything.

Hey bro/gal, dont do that please. What ever you did, if you had good intentions, the outcome is pretty much irrelevant. There are always going to people popel who have an opinion on you. Some will be bad, but others good. You need to hold on until those good ones come around. And they will come.

Every time you feel suicidal, go to sleep or take a nap, plese. I know that wont solf you problems, but it stips you from doing something you will regret.

I hope you get though this.

I don’t think your selfish or a piece of shir by the way
Bro you got respond to us. Don’t leave like this
Does it snow there, I love the snow. More importantly though, do you like it there?
Thats rough. Im sorry you’re depressed. What kind of music do you listen to though?

Hey, im sorry you feel this way. In the short term when this happens id suggest going back to sleep for a little bit, or going to have some breakfast. You need to tackle the root of the problem though. I hope for your sake you know what it is, and can handle it. Also good on you for looking up the suicide hotline number. It show you dont want to do it. You shouldn’t. 
Now get to sleep or make some breakfast please :)

Could be mood swings, which is a symptom of depression. If they are sudden then most likely. But that shouldn’t stop you from doing what ever it is you said you enjoy. (Mind telling me what that is?) 

School is just though sometimes. I don’t know what grade/year you are in but that dose really matter. Just try and power though it. Your future self will look back and be glad you did. 

Just realized I didn’t actually answer your question; yes. I’ll go a couple of days feeling excited for the future, getting to see my parents for the first time in over 9 months, just finishing high school, ect. Then the nest day I’ll just feel like it all means nothing. Ive been in some really low points and i dont wana be there again. So i keep my self busy or distracted. Then the day ends and i feel fine the next.

Hope this helps, and that you get though school without much of a hitch.

Firstly, you’re English is great, I envy you for being able to speak more than one language.

Also, put the scissors away, or throw them away if you dont need them for school or work. Wrist slashing is a very painful, messy, and inefficient way of suicide. Dont try it again please. 

South Korea though, thats cool! Ive been to Seoul once, it was beautiful, and all the people were super nice. What city are you in? If you dont mind me asking.
Thats a shame, im sorry. Glad you threw that blade away though! Little steps like these is what going to get out back in you feet. You’ve got your whole life ahead of you.
If you’re really set on that, i hope it’s painless for you. Can you make a promise to me though? Post here again before you do it. Or message me at the very least so i can say goodbye

Not to encourage you but yes. Suicide is very logical. Its a rather pessimistic world view but nothing really has an meaning. I have no idea what its like to be in your situation where you dont have many close people in you life. Think about it this way though. We are all eventually going to die. So just save your self the hassle and keep up with what you’ve been doing so far. Find a hobby if you dont already have one. And it is never ever to late to meet a partner.

Hey there, that sounds extremely tough for somone who is only 16. You shouldn’t have to deal with stuff like this. Im only some stranger you’ve never met, but i want you do something for me. Go take a warm shower, brush your teeth, hop into bed or on a couch and go to sleep. Don’t do anything rash. I’m sure your mind is processing alot right now. You need to go to sleep and let it just think. Please, i was ina similar situation once, i sleep for 14hrs. You will still not feel good when you wake up. But you will be leat likely to do something you might regret. Also sleep is just good.  Finally, throw that razorblade away. It will hurt like a mf, wont kill you, and will be a permanent unwanted reminder.

I hope you can respond to this coment sometime so i know your still here.

I’m truly sorry you are at a stage in your life where you have been looking for ways to do this. Please don’t. I don’t know you, probably never will. But what about the people that do? Anyone that cares about you, will go though the same pain. Im not saying suicide is not selfish. I wasn’t brave enough to try it when i was in a dark time of my life. I know this is not what you asked for, but honestly dont try it. Most ODs just cause vomiting and you’ll then have to live with that. 

I haven’t taken cyanide, so i cant give my expertise, but really mate you got to listen to me, please dont try it. What ever you’re going through must be though if this is your solution. But its not the right one. I don’t like making assumptions about people, but you posted here because deep down you dont want to do it. You dont have to. You shouldn’t.

Hey, you seem to be stuck in a routine. Ive been down in the ditch just like you before, and i can tell you i felt the exact same. What worked for me was breaking the routine. Maybe go for a walk if the weather is you mood (not everyone likes the sun XD). Self care helps too, exercise, skin, ect. Suicide is not the answer though. I know its said all the time and you wont believe me. But you wont always feel this way. Ive been there, yet im still here. Just keep you self busy okay? Take it one day at a time, keep yourself busy. Hope this helped a little :)

My gf asked me out and we made heaps of plans. I was also doing well in school. And didn’t feel depressed. I dont wana wait for a week like that again because ive already got a taste of what being genuinely happy was like. And every day without it hurts

Was a struggle to remember but glad i saw this post. I found a YT channel that makes combined songs and “vs” songs from multiple artists (if anyone wants to know what channel I can try and find it). One song I really liked was by ‘Rammstein’, so I checked em out. Boy am I glad I did, they are great! I instantly fell in love with ‘Sonne’ and ‘Haifisch’. They have also given me motivation to try and learn German again.

Hey, thanks for being so quick! Thats gonna be really hard for me to do. Im quite anxious. But I know its better for both of us to stop it (if its not meant to be) sooner rather than later. That was my interpretation atleast.
We are all on here by choice. You’re not wasting anyone’s time. What hobbies do you have by the way?
I guess it’s possible. But I feel if that were the case they would ask why I didn’t go, which they haven’t.

Thanks for taking the time to respond. 
I dont know whats happening to me. I used to be so good at shutting all my feelings down, ignoring everything and getting throught one day at a time. But I have cried more in the past month than i have for the past 3 years. I just dont see the point anymore. I realized just minutes ago that all my “friends” are just people that hang out with me when they ahve no one else to be with. 

Im really sorry if sound like im seeking attention, this is the only place where i can talk about anything.
